title: A Choir for the Wolf
author: Ansel Eastwick
blurb: Odile Voss, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
